description: Searches Walmart for `query` and returns the products as JSON: `name`, `price` and `wasPrice`, `rating`, `reviewCount`, `brand`, `seller`, `availability`, `image` and a product `url`. Sort with `sort`, filter with `min_price`/`max_price`, and collect up to `max_results` across pages. Returns JSON. Billed like an API request; listing plugins bill one unit per result page they fetch, so keep max_results modest.

max_results.description: How many products to collect across pages. Default: 40.

page.description: 1-based page to start from (~40 per page). Default: 1.

proxy_country.description: Proxy country the request is sent from (ISO-2, e.g. 'US', 'DE'). Defaults to US.

query.description: What to search, e.g. 'laptop' or 'coffee maker'.

sort.description: Ordering: best_match, price_low, price_high, best_seller, rating_high, new. Default: best_match.

name: walmart_search
title: Scrape Walmart product search
